meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 把设计对照迪特·拉姆斯的十条原则逐项打分(0–3分),每项附证据,得出新建/细化/重设计结论,并生成一条可直接交给 /make-plan 的提示。全程不写代码,只出评分、结论与交接文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计某个设计、进行设计评审,或要求给出能导向设计计划的批判时触发。日常代码审查、纯文案修改、尚无设计稿的构思不适用。

say.text: 审计这个设计,按 Rams 十原则打分并给出结论。
say.note: Claude 会收集证据、产出评分卡和结论文件。

say.text: 检查这个 UI 是否符合 Rams 原则,然后给我重设计计划。
say.note: 会生成可交给 /make-plan 的提示。

say.text: 批判这个设计,并生成 /make-plan 交接提示。

howto.what_en: Audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with evidence, gives a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict, and produces a /make-plan handoff prompt. No code output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to audit a design, do a design review, check a UI against Rams, or request a critique that leads to a plan. Not for routine code reviews or copy edits.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles and score it.
say_en.note: Runs evidence gathering and outputs the scorecard.

say_en.text: Check this UI against Rams, then give me a refine plan.
say_en.note: Produces a REFINE verdict and a /make-plan prompt.

say_en.text: Critique this design and generate a /make-plan handoff.
